participation.context: Told the window, the war of the houses, and the boy underneath, and reached for the tables.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Answered with stinkweed, and with the hardness on her and then on him.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: a line has to sell as well as smell

story.body: You gave her the window and the name. She priced it as a thing cried in the street, and then she priced the boy who has to be the girl.

relations.note: a line has to sell as well as smell

title: Tried the rose on Alse and heard stinkweed

participation.context: Copied, and left the line as it stood.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You put the dawn, the basket, and the carrier's line onto the sheet. You were not making the line over again.

participation.context: Supplied the second line. She had already gone down.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

story.body: You wrote what you had tried on her, and then what she had answered.

title: Put Alse's stinkweed under the rose

participation.context: Wrote them, and turned the second leaf.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You drafted both, left the name off both, and put the second face down.

title: Wrote two leaves, and turned one over

participation.context: Turned the leaf. His face is not in it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You turned it, and you left the hand in the picture and the face out.

title: Left the second leaf face down
